name: opendss_altdss_library

support_targets.opendss: EPRI OpenDSS; online documentation is mixed-version

validation.source_review: Line/LineCode and Phase 3A passed independent QA/QC and required corrections are applied. The owner accepted Phase 3B packages 1 through 5. Package 6 (Generator) passed coder validation, independent QA/QC (PASS, no required corrections), and the architect review (PASS WITH FINDINGS: E-1 numeric enum text writes silently discarded, E-2 EPRI default divergences not disclosed, A-1 to A-5 architect handoff corrections, O-1 narrowed to Capacitor), and awaits the owner's disposition. It completes the six-package Phase 3B implementation sequence.
validation.schema_validation: The Generator validation run passed 15/15 manifest and catalog schema pairs (Draft 2020-12 with format checking, jsonschema 4.26.0); the architect review re-ran it at the same result on 2026-11-21 local.
validation.runtime: All 14 catalogued examples passed on Windows 11 AMD64 with Python 3.14.6, altdss 0.2.4, dss-python 0.15.7, and backend 0.14.5; the architect review re-ran the harness and reproduced the package-6 matrix identically, including the environment block. Phase 3B packages 1 through 6 have readback matrices.

known_gaps: Three catalog files are still empty pending later phases: opendss_objects, python_interface_comparison, troubleshooting.

The generated altdss_python_api catalog covers object and collection classes and the AltDSS context. Non-element context interfaces, context batch proxies, and internal _str proxies are outside the catalog scope.

dss_capi.json covers Line, LineCode, LineGeometry, LineSpacing, WireData, CNData, TSData, Circuit creation, Vsource, Transformer, XfmrCode, Load, Capacitor, and Generator, including inherited fields used in these packages.
Transformer and XfmrCode coverage is limited to two and three windings. AutoTrans is deferred pending an owner scope decision.
LoadShape and GrowthShape property catalogs are deferred. The Load package covers the Load element and its shape-assignment behavior only.
Property-level source_refs remain partial for Line/LineCode (E-3 deferred); new element packages require per-row citations.
Fixture-based validation with IEEE 13- and 34-node circuits and golden results is planned for Phase 4; no golden fixtures exist yet.
The beta package line (AltDSS-Python 0.3.0b2 and later) is documented as future compatibility only and not validated.
EPRI online pages do not state one OpenDSS version; version-sensitive claims need release-specific confirmation.
The legacy line catalog and builder are retained for provenance and are not active inputs.
CapControl is a deferred controller catalog. The Capacitor package covers the Capacitor element and the States control hook only.
The Capacitor element has no Spectrum property, unlike Load and Vsource.

The shared element schema now declares enum_type, reference_class, and dss_text_keyword. Optional array and write-path metadata cited in Capacitor architect finding O-1 still needs shared schema declarations.
GenDispatcher, CapControl, InvControl, PVSystem and Storage are deferred controller or element catalogs; the element packages cover element behavior and control hooks only.

Generator's built-in dispatch settings and separate GenDispatcher control are source-reviewed. The Model 3 snapshots use the default PVFactor; sensitivity to changing it is source-reviewed. Compiled models, dynamic studies, harmonics, and fuel consumption are outside runtime scope.
next_actions: Disposition Phase 3B package 6 (Generator) and the Phase 3 exit gate. Independent QA/QC and the architect review both report pass; the owner decides whether findings E-1 (silent enum text writes) and E-2 (undisclosed EPRI default divergences) are applied first.

Resolve the remaining shared schema declarations for Capacitor array and write-path metadata: array_element_type, array_length, readback_type, dss_text_write, python_write_status, python_creation_status, python_method (Capacitor architect review O-1; Load and Generator are now fully declared).
Plan the Phase 4 golden fixture set and harness after the Phase 3 exit gate, ahead of the first fixture.
